text.en:
Tariff heading No. 85.20 of Section 104 of Republic Act No. 1937, as modified by Executive Order
No. 456, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The articles specifically listed hereunder as classified under Section 104 of Republic Act No. 1937
shall pay the following rates of import duty:
Tariff Heading Number
Description of Articles
Rate of Duty
85.20
….
A. Infra-red and ultra-violet lamp bulbs including reflector and mercury lamp bulbs; lamp bulbs for motor
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
